protocol.seed: CLI-controlled; use the same --seed for every training run

measurement_protocol.pretrained: Disabled ONLY in profiling memory; no download or YAML edits
measurement_protocol.scope: One detector forward; no transforms/postprocessor/criterion/MERT training
measurement_protocol.environment_scope: Selective source import does NOT verify dataset or full training dependencies; no dependency/model stubs are used.
measurement_protocol.model_process_isolation: Fresh subprocess per method avoids global registry leakage
measurement_protocol.flops_warning: LOWER BOUNDS, NOT total model FLOPs. Profiler zero-FLOP operators include grid sampling, normalization, softmax, fused attention, and some SECD arithmetic; operator list also includes metadata. Hook MACs count only executed Conv2d/Linear modules, not functional attention projections. 2*MACs is stated only for the hook metric.

Baseline == MERT.uncounted_events_note: Diagnostic only: PyTorch 2.0 Windows event counts can vary even for repeats of the same model/config. Actual module execution trace is compared separately.
